description: Development screen: 36-week sampled MLPs trained leave-one-season-out on NHSN seasons 2022-23 through 2025-26, evaluated on 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. Finalized training inputs and weekly labels; square-root counts, local noise, neighboring-state exchange, path and peak loss weights 1. Add a differentiable log-probability loss for the true future peak week at weight 0.3 or 1. Seasonal comparison replays archived Wednesday reports without final-value fallback on matched FluSight-ensemble tasks. This is retrospective development evaluation, not an untouched or forward-only test.
